page.overview:
Who is Violet Bazaar?

Violet Bazaar (Born c. 1979-1980) is a girl in Bart's 4th grade class at Springfield Elementary School, she is also the daughter of Pomona Bazaar and Walter Bazaar, she is the younger sister to Alberta and Hazel Bazaar.

She is first seen in the school's Christmas pageant, singing Jingle Bells. She later goes on an excursion to Springfield Nuclear Power Plant, to see Homer get fired by Sherri and Terri's father. She is part of the Future Photographers of America, along with Adrian Belew, and begs Bart for a copy of his photo of Homer dancing with Princess Kashmir, but he says no. She also plays the timpani in the Springfield Elementary School Band.
